entities.name: FtsH-like protease
observations: The 652-aa query is a strong FtsH-family match: closest listed reviewed hit Q1LLA9 has 62.3% identity and 92.8% query coverage (E=3.43e-268).
Pfam detected FtsH_ext at 21–110, AAA at 206–338, AAA_lid_3 at 360–403, and Peptidase_M41 at 419–607.
Likely inner-membrane ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease; function inferred from close reviewed FtsH homologs, not experimentally established for this query.
Sequence-derived estimates: 71,515 Da and theoretical pI 5.81.
Close reviewed homolog annotations support zinc binding, ATP-dependent proteolysis, cytoplasmic-facing inner-membrane localization, and homohexameric assembly.

entities.name: FtsH Q1LLA9
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Cupriavidus metallidurans; annotated as ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease FtsH, acting in protein quality control and degradation.

entities.name: Zn2+
observations: Reviewed FtsH homolog annotations report one zinc ion bound per subunit; this cofactor assignment is homology-based for the query.
